description.en: An energetic and bold visual experience for the Afterglow Market, showcasing the electrifying atmosphere of food, music, and design.
description.zh: 为余晖市场提供一个充满活力和大胆的视觉体验，展示美食、音乐和设计的令人振奋的氛围。

directions.promptModifier: Composition: a large central abstract graphic made from vibrant shapes and organic forms that suggest movement and excitement, overlaid with key text elements prominently displayed. Palette: a bright and dynamic color scheme featuring electric blues, vivid pinks, and sunny yellows, creating high contrast and energy. Materials: smooth digital textures with a slight grain for depth, creating an immersive visual feel. Typography: bold, playful sans-serif for the event name, complemented by a condensed typeface for the details, ensuring readability from a distance. Mood: youthful, energetic, and inviting, capturing the essence of a lively community gathering.

description.en: A nostalgic yet fresh visual direction that highlights the retro aspect of vinyl records while promoting the Afterglow Market as a community event.
description.zh: 一种怀旧而新鲜的视觉风格，突出黑胶唱片的复古特征，同时将余晖市场作为社区活动进行推广。

directions.promptModifier: Composition: a collage of retro vinyl records arranged in a dynamic diagonal layout, integrating the event details within the grooves and labels of the records. Palette: warm earth tones with pops of teal and coral to evoke a vintage feel while staying vibrant and appealing. Materials: a textured paper background resembling an old album cover, with glossy stickers for the key details to add a playful touch. Typography: a mix of retro sans-serif and script fonts, with the event name in larger playful script and details in a clean sans-serif for clarity. Mood: nostalgic yet fresh, inviting attendees to enjoy a lively evening filled with music and community spirit.

description.en: Embracing simplicity and clarity, this direction focuses on geometric shapes to create an eye-catching design for the Afterglow Market.
description.zh: 采用简单明了的设计风格，这一方向利用几何形状为余晖市场创造引人注目的视觉效果。

directions.promptModifier: Composition: a series of overlapping geometric shapes forming a balanced layout that guides the eye towards the event details, with ample negative space to enhance readability. Palette: a muted pastel color scheme, incorporating soft pinks, greens, and blues, lending a modern and fresh feel while maintaining visibility. Materials: smooth matte finishes to emphasize the clean look, combined with sharp paper cuts or laser-cut elements for added depth. Typography: a modern sans-serif typeface used consistently for all text elements, featuring a large headline for the event name with a subtle shadow effect, enhancing legibility. Mood: calm yet energetic, focusing on a sleek and contemporary representation of the community event.
